title: Certify complete block-cascade conditioning and audit paid-word admission (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Exact finite audit and elementary norm proof: the complete cyclic observation matrices proposed in #4818, #4819 and #4826 have sharp Euclidean condition number **3** (norm 3/2 and inverse norm 2). Their reported 9/7 and 8193/8191 bounds control a loop closure factor; they do not bound the complete cascade. Invertibility and the weaker bound 16 survive.

The package also gives a concrete counterexample to using #4813's conditional plus-swap-sector cancellation on a general input: `e1` produces coordinate-zero error `−(1+i)/4`. This describes a conditional-rule misuse, not a claim that the source asserts the conditional identity without its premise. A positive exact check confirms #4826's monomial residual factorization at its literal 32-coordinate width.

Only `research/complex-block-schedule-admission-audit/` is added. No paid-call optimum, new κ or selected-frontier change follows. Actual chronological call realization, all-input ownership and restoration, raw inverse transpose, all-width lift, finite work/precision, complete caller and compiler/outer transfer remain open. Source matrix construction and injective recovery are not a priced physical word.

## Task and overlap

Base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`; task `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 7. Scope changed by explicit assignment to auditing newly proposed small-unit schedules before using their headline savings.

Audited heads: #4813 `f982ecc06826e7087e69b9468d3ff52589fd0822`; #4818 `fd29d065bbe12f5be5af02fdf5a8b4d86dda3381`; #4819 `a7b42c2f8ffe5a18d305ca4dda5729d2f1d72ea8`; #4826 `d7b53d3992e658f0dd49d0207ba33bbc39272bac`. Five unchanged source files are retained, with original Git blobs, exact hashes and immutable URLs in ORIGINS.json; no unmerged Git object is required at runtime.

Bounded live PR-body queries and all four comment timelines were checked; no comments were present. #4828's exact sharp conditioning result concerns #4743's two-bank port and explicitly excludes these cascades. #4835 concerns a characteristic-zero finite-test kernel. This work checks different concrete matrices. The heads and canonical main were refreshed unchanged at 2026-10-22 21:42 UTC. This is not exhaustive novelty or unpublished-work coverage; refresh discussions before taking the handoff.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-block-schedule-admission-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-block-schedule-admission-audit/verify.py

```

Local environment: Python 3.12.3, Linux. Exact eigenvector witnesses attain both norm bounds. Every entry of the 48- and 96-square assembled matrices and all 208 columns of the thirteen-bank forward method are compared to an independently evaluated permutation cycle. Source constructors are reused and disclosed; source bytes are authenticated before execution, and AST prefixes use those same authenticated bytes. The source's complete rank/test suites are not replayed.

Actual separate-process mutations reject a changed retained-source byte and a false `new_kappa` receipt in a temporary Git-free export under optimized Python. The scientific checker uses explicit exceptions. No Lean, all-size native replay, complete compiler, selected-frontier scientific replay, independent human review is claimed; hosted execution is recorded below.

A successful word then needs complete-caller pricing and funded compiler/outer transfer.

The latest targeted PR-body search for 4826 and cascade conditioning still returns only the original proposals, #4828 and our distinct #4839 centre-chain terminal. The bounded live handoff board was read; its loaded newest/oldest windows do not establish complete Discussion pagination. No competing exact cascade certificate was found in this inspected coverage.
